name: Missouri

jury_list.statute: No Missouri statute opens or closes records of persons found not qualified as non-citizens. RSMo 494.410.4: 'The names on the master jury list shall be considered a public record.' 494.415.2: if a juror qualification form shows a person is not qualified, 'Such names shall be deleted from the master jury list.' 494.425(2) disqualifies 'Any person not a citizen of the United States'. Status: null.

sources.cite: RSMo 494.410.4 (names on the master jury list are a public record)
RSMo 494.415 (juror qualification form; disqualified names deleted from the master list)
RSMo 494.425(2) (any person not a U.S. citizen is disqualified)
RSMo 494.465.2 (in a jury-selection challenge, a party may use 'relevant records and papers not public or otherwise available used by the board of jury commissioners')

voter_file.who_may_get: Any member of the public: electronic media or printouts showing only voter ID number, name, year of birth, address, township or ward, and precinct (RSMo 115.157.1).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Not stated for the basic list. Lists of who voted in an election may not be used for commercial purposes (115.157.3).

private_challenge.who: No private pre-election challenge was found. The election authority must investigate material affecting a voter's qualifications brought to it from any source (RSMo 115.191). Poll challengers are designated by party chairs (115.105).

county_board.name: Missouri Secretary of State - local election authorities
county_board.note: Under RSMo 115.191 the local election authority must investigate information about a voter's qualifications.

audit_path.statute: RSMo 610.023 (Sunshine Law) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the local election authority: per year, the number of registrations cancelled because the registrant was not a U.S. citizen, and the number of RSMo 115.191 investigations on that ground.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Missouri statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. Whether election authorities keep counts by reason was not confirmed.

gates.basis: Jury records: no Missouri statute opens or closes records of persons found not qualified (null), so counts only. The public master jury list (494.410.4) names potential jurors, not persons disqualified; disqualified names are deleted (494.415.2). No private challenge; information may go to the election authority (RSMo 115.191). Strict gates.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (494.410.4, 494.415.2, 494.425(2)); jury sources; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null. official_pipeline stays null. No voter_file value changes.

PA-style check: 494.410.4 makes the names on the master jury list a public record. Disqualified names are deleted from that list (494.415.2, 494.415.4); no section keeps or opens a list of who was deleted or why. 494.465.2 calls some board records 'not public'.
official_pipeline is null: no Missouri statute sends juror citizenship information to election officials. The NCSL table of jury-list pipelines (updated Sept. 1, 2026) does not list Missouri.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Missouri cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
The public list shows year of birth only and no registration date (115.157.1).
Source note: revisor.mo.gov read with curl on 2026-10-07.
